title: Here and now
grammar: Present Continuous, contrast with Present Simple

phases.name: Presentation
phases.content: In this unit you will learn the Present Continuous tense to describe actions happening right now. You will also compare it with the Present Simple.

phases.name: Discovery
phases.content: Read these sentences. I am reading a book. She is wearing a red dress. They are playing football. Notice the structure: am/is/are + verb-ing.

phases.name: Guided practice
phases.explanation: For actions happening now we use Present Continuous: is + verb-ing.

phases.name: Free practice
phases.prompt: Look around you and write 3 sentences about what people are doing right now.

phases.name: Mini-test
phases.prompt: I usually ___ coffee, but today I ___ tea.
phases.explanation: Usually goes with Present Simple, today with Present Continuous.
